CustomField.description: IM-232:This field is used in program overview to show Total Committed Amount for different initiatives.
CustomField.formula: IF( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Budgeted_Initiative', Approved_Amount__c, IF( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Budgeted_Initiative', ( Misc_Total_Paid_Amount_USD__c + Misc_Total_Scheduled_Amount_USD__c ), IF( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Amendment', Change_Total_Amount__c, 0)))
CustomField.label: Total Committed Amount (USD)
